text: Food and service were great.  I had the popper Burger and my daughter had the chicken tenders. Both were great.  Do yourself a favor and get the onion rings.

We Brought the boys for brunch for the first time and the hospitality was amazing!  They got a complimentary pastry to try and really enjoyed the food. My wife and I are regulars and as usual we loved the food and service. The chicken and French toast were absolutely amazing, and my steak and egg sandwich was on point as usual!  Our server Husam was fast, accurate and responsive and even brought me a few extra candy apricots for my drink!  A++. Regardless of the wait I would highly recommend this place.

This afternoon my other half and I were craving    In 'n Out burgers so off we went.
We stopped at the Oro Valley location and Inwas not disappointed. 
I ordered mx usual, Grilled Cheese with fresh onion,  fries and a drink. My guy? He had the Double Double,  fries and drink.
So far I don't believe I've been disappointed in my meal. It's always has fresh quality produce, sandwich buns and delicious sauce or Spread as they call it.
Yes, they are enforcing having customers  stand at the yellow line. I'm all about  helping each other stay healthy, it's fine and expected but the guy taking my order had a difficult time hearing me  It was frustrating for me and I'm sure for him since he has me speaking in front of him and his fellow associates talking and cooking behind him. 
Overall, still a 5 star because the food is delicious. And they offer 7 Up from their soda fountain.

Worst service ever... seriously... I'm giving it 2 stars cause the food is great. So if you want delivery or takeout this is your place! But don't bother coming here to dine in, you'll be very frustrated the whole time.

The Apple Walnut  salad was excellent. The ingredients were fresh and plentiful. The black and blue burger was really good and loaded with blue cheese. The fried pickles were lightly battered and very tasty served with two different sauces. 
The staff that took the order and made the food was friendly and the food was prepared quickly. 
This is a "Family Friendly" restaurant that offers free meals to kids on Saturday. This is awesome if you have a large family with small children but it makes for tight quarters on a Saturday night. 
While we found the black and blue burger just right, the Pioneer Burgers were greasy, not sure why but perhaps the cheese makes the difference. 
One note is that if you're paying with a credit card, the screen will ask if you'd like to add a tip. Since this was our first visit, we weren't aware that no service was provided but all aspects of our visit were "self serve". If I visit again, I won't feel guilty to choose the "no tip" option - it's there!
We were traveling through and looking for a good burger which we found here. Some of the down sides weren't mentioned in other Yelp reviews we read and while they're not deal breakers, we wish we had known going in so included them here.

Ordered one platter and one sandwich but they gave two sandwiches instead which I didn't realize until I reached home. 

Taste wise the food was alright.. not bad, not great.

Please provide me with an option to tip the cooks who did THEIR jobs with excellent food, and not the idiot children  you have pretending to be servers, while focusing on hanging around at the hostess stand, gossiping and checking their phones, ignoring their tables that have  that need basics like coffee.

I love this place. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. The Jenn the new manager always makes you feel very welcome even when they have a line to the door. The food is great but I come more for the customer service.

Online ordering and picking up was easy peasy. You pick the date and time, pick your goodies, put in payment info (and coupon code!). Click, drive to the store, and BAM delicious food! Employees were super cheerful and helpful, as always. #TakeOutChallenge

Had a random craving for pad Thai and have yet to find a place near me that compared to my favorite at my last apartment. I'll have to say my search continues. It was more fishy and sour than I would've liked. But the calamari wasn't bad.

This place is like a diner.  Pretty fast service.  They start you with a danish basket which is little pieces of varies breakfast breads.  I thought this was a nice touch so you can eat something before your main meal comes.  I got the Egg's benedict.  Eggs were poached well.  Muffin could have been toasted more.  Hollandaise was made well, though it was a bit pale in color, not sure why.  It came with home fries potatoes.  I would have liked it if they could have crisped it up more.  Overall, I think I'd return here.

I really want to give a higher rating, the food taste great but every time I eat it I get sick. And it's not just me my whole entire family. I love the way the food taste, I've had a bunch of sandwiches here and it taste great. But it almost always makes me get sick amd my family as well.

Food was extremely overpriced for bland pizza! But what ruined our entire experience was the rude manager, Caleb! Unwilling to be understanding, helpful, ANNND tossed our leftovers after  THEY forgot to bring them out. He refused to even offer a coupon and ACTUALLY SAID, "all I can tell you is don't forget your leftovers next time." Wow. Never going back there for mediocre pizza. Hopefully the owner can see this review.
I love them. I don't have much to say but their parm sauce is bomb and you can't go wrong with any pizza choice. Go jockamos.

Aroma is a fantastic find, how it is not a solid 5 stars is lost on me! I will not be able to share enough positive elements in this post, but in short do yourself a favor and go and enjoy. We attempted to order as great of a variety as possible so we could sample different things. We ordered the mini dip sampler the Mixed Kebab Dinner Platter and the Chicken Shwarma. We were also treated to a baklava for dessert. It started off great with the wonderful Dolma, not a soggy mess as they sometimes are served other places, these were wonderful with a crisp flavor, I could enjoy a plate of those alone. The dips were all top notch and well done, Muhammara is a delightful red pepper based dip and the beet dip had a little hint of sweet to it. Lamb kebab is often the test in my experience, it can be good or it can sink the entire meal. Aroma hit it out of the park! All of the proteins were well seasoned and perfectly cooked. Not to be lost was the rice and grilled veggies that themselves bear mentioning, I know rice and veggies...easy to just throw them in, but not at Aroma, each element is clearly given care and attention! From the salsa that was a terrific complement to the lamb to the pita that was not stiff like cardboard but provided a warm delicious wrap that delivered each excellent bite, this meal was simply outstanding. I always try to offer something constructive in a review, about the only thing I could think to offer is the garlic sauce was a little heavy on the mayo. All
I live in CT an hour from NYC, for some reason it's hard to get Honduran food around here. Visited NOLA baleadas were really good. Portions were large. Will be back when I return

This is now my new favorite burger joint. Their meats are ground in house daily! They offer different sauces such as garlic mayo and AB sauce. The burgers were juicy and taste so good. We order the atomic burger and some sliders. One of the opt for sliders was the jamburger. It had bacon and onion jam on it and that's where I feel in love lol. So yummy! Fries are fresh hand cut. I'll definitely be back for and to try out their shakes!! 

The restaurant looks like a chain place but it's actually locally own with another location in Baton Rouge.

Everything was soo good! We tried the tommy G's wings and the combination pizza... very tasty! Wings came with caramelized onions and the flavor was a savory lemon that was perfectly cooked. We ate every last bite omg!
Very slow service on online orders I always wait for them. I believe thats something they dont care at all.

The cronut and glazed donuts are the best! Though you can't go wrong with any of their donuts. The pumpkin one is very moist and delicious. Overall, the donuts are yummy and fresh consistently and you can't beat the price. Highly recommend!!!

Ordered delivery during the pandemic. We got a sandwich, rigatoni alla vodka, and pizza fries. The food was great and the service was fantastic. The food was still hot and crispy when it arrived. Definitely would recommend!

It's Tom and Gisele's loss that they reside now in Davis Island but don't dine out. It is OUR gain. This little Italian restaurant tucked in the heart of Davis Island square has captured my heart at dining al fresco in the alley. It's the most authentic European vibe I have gotten in a restaurant in Tampa, and it feels cozy and I love it. The food is top-notch and I really enjoyed every bite of everything we ordered. The portions are generous and the wait time to get a table was nil due to their OpenTable reservation system. All in all, it was a perfect date night away from North Tampa suburbs where these parents are from. We can't wait to be back and dine al fresco in front of the restaurant next time. We really enjoyed the steamed mussels and diablo pasta with sausages. They weren't too hot. Just medium spicy with hint of sweetness, which is how I hope my husband likes to describe my personality.
Knock of old town road and pretty bad service but good food........that's all it makes me right more so i will right random let wor d s

Looove this place so much. Get the beet salad !!! I love how even their side salads have such big portions. Their tomato soup is also wonderful. They offer gluten free bread that is very yummy but it is $2 extra and smaller than their normal bread so your sandwich will be smaller, so it might be worth it to just eat normal bread if you can. They have a really good covid- safe pickup process, which is a plus!
I wish I could add more stars. This is the best bagel shop in Philly hands down. True New York bagels and endless options. Price beats everyone else and better then everyone else.
I love the gf street noodles.  Everyone has their favorite.  A menu that's refreshing in that it's different yet not so different that it's scary to try something new.

Very disappointing for a $10 sandwich. A bit of browning on avocados is understandable, but this is extreme and borderline inedible. Panera's online support acted as though it's a Door Dash issue and that they should issue refund. Frankly, the quality of your ingredients is what Panera preaches most. Things happen but thumbs down for the way it was handled.

One man shop, from chef to serve.  The BBQ is decent, but price friendly.     The brisket could be more juicy, the rib could be more tasty, the fish cold be more smokey.  All have room for improvement, but for that price and owner operated.  That worth an extra star.

I don't think the pandemic sunk them - it was poor quality and service.  When they first opened, they were OK, but JUST OK. Went there a few more times, and each time the service got worse, and ultimately, the last few times my burgers were not cooked to order When burgers are a part of your name, you should damn well get them right every single time.  Stopped going a couple of years ago. Too bad... the concept had potential, but it never lived up to it.

My husband and I had a date night and decided to order from Red Robin to go since we are unable to go out to eat with the pandemic. We have been to Red Robin in the past and we're happy with our past experiences in the restaurant in the past. We especially love a good burger and bottomless steak fries. 
The online ordering process was super easy. We had to do pickup because we live too far from the restaurant, about 25 minutes. We places our order of a teriyaki chicken burger and the impossible burger as we are limiting our red meat. There was an option to order extra fries at no extra charge so we added that for the traditional steak fries and the garlic fries for an extra $1.50 up-charge. Our total including tip was $35.
When we went to pick it up, there was a counter pulled up to the front door that said "2 Go Pickup" and I was greeted. She asked me my name and went to grab my order. When I got home, we opened our food and tasted everything. The fries were the best part, but I was not a fan of the garlic fries. Also, the grilled pineapple on teriyaki burger was canned and flavorless, which was very disappointing. The taste was just not there. Also, the impossible burger was alright but was not the best I've had. If we go back it'll be in person and most likely would do a beef burger since we were disappointed with our non-beef options. I felt for what we paid we would have been happier with a burger from Burger King.

Had the "lemon pepper" wings (which that advertise).  May have just gone and bought a carton of salt and ate that. That's all I tasted was salt. And the fries could be more greasy. The bag was saturated with grease. Will not be back.

This place has gone downhill since we started coming 7 years ago.

We ordered chicken pad see ew,  and it came (delivered) with no brown sauce.  The chicken pad Thai had 1 strip of pepper and sauce had no flavor.  Crab rangoons had no crab,  just cream cheese.

Pretty good.  Hubby wouldn't mind coming back when COVID is done to sit down and watch the game and chill and try out their tap beer. Right next to PF Chang at Westshore mall. I ordered the cod battered fish and chips. Even though it looks too fried, it was still really good, the fries on the other hand were nasty.  I also got the ginger teriyaki chicken wings and can't even taste the ginger, it was so so good and had left overs the following day and it was still crispy. Most likely will order this again when we go back or whenever I'm craving teriyaki chicken wings, get some for take out. Hubby had the St. Patty Smelt.  He liked it a lot, but pass on those boxy.  It was just literally fried mash potatoes.  He said it's good trying out and shared with like 3 people, 1 is good enough for 1 person.

This place is consistent with its food and service.  Very kid friendly and relaxed atmosphere when you want something a little better than fast food and don't mind waiting a few minutes for the food to be fired up on the grill.  This place is one of our usual options when it's a casual family dinner night out.  Kids always love the milkshakes, kids meals and fries and the possibility of running into one of their friends too.

This is not your usual clayton find. If you're looking for something more relaxed, a friendly staff that isn't too hard on the wallet, this is your place. Food is outstanding. The chicken wings are my go to and you can't go wrong with a mini fielder or the mini chicken fielders. Christine, the day bartender is by far my favorite girl to visit! Outstanding service.

I've had Petra a few times in the shop but over the weekend we ordered delivery through the Yelp app and it couldn't have been easier. In fact, I fear that it was almost so easy that I'll be leaning on this option more in the future  

Our group ordered everything from the chicken shawarma platter to the falafel pita sandwich served with fries. My Shawarma platter with rice, chicken, feta and tatziki sauce was very flavorful and generously portioned. In fact, it almost could have served two. From the time our order was placed, it took 45 minutes (as scheduled) to receive the food.  Overall, a very smooth and tasty  experience. 

If you're looking to visit their brick and mortar it's conveniently located in the heart of the Mass Ave district with lots of fun neighboring shops. Parking is easier during the lunch hours than at night.
Excellent food and service here! Mark & Nicole treat their customers well. The restaurant is always clean. Keep up the good work!

Stopped in for dinner while on vacation in New Orleans. The food was terrific and the staff friendly and attentive. They never let our glasses go empty and the food was some of the best we've ever had. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area.

My new favorite Mexican spot! Everything we ordered was divinely delicious and fresh! Best guacamole I've had...quite possibly ever! You don't get an overwhelming amount, but it's reasonably priced for its quality. Steak quesadilla wasn't in the style I'm traditionally used to, but it was probably all the more authentic and definitely hit the spot. My el pastor burrito was amazing as well. Can't wait to order takeout again and looking forward to when we can dine in again!
Always great service and food. The only thing I'm sad about is that they take paleo heaven off the menu:(
It was not as good as I remember and definitely not like jacks pizza.. it was just ok..
Roasted cauliflower is to die for. Only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was due to the drinks. The drinks lacked flavor and the ingredients just didn't mix well. Does not matter tho I will be back!

Okay, per the owners recommendation, I decided to try for a good experience again. Let's start with the good: I liked the churros.  not amazing by any means but they hit the spot: crunchy, seasoned nicely and not greasy at all. Now the bad: I paid extra for the steak in my burritos it was nearly nowhere to be found. The white rice was very over cooked and smushed together. If I hadn't gotten beans and rice in the burrito I'm not sure what they would have filled it with? I included a picture of the burrito showing the proportions on inside ingredients. For as expensive as this meal was, it was such a let down. But now I know. Couple of extra annoyances: they left out my sour cream on side. (Had to split my husbands small side with him), I was unable to redeem my $10 for $15 yelp purchased promo via grub hub delivery. Quesadilla was pretty stingy portion for $11. Couple of extra things I appreciated: burrito was wrapped well and tight, food was warm (Warmer delivered than eating a chipotle burrito dine in) All in all, not sure I'll even be back to spend my $10 for $15 from yelp deal.

It was a beautiful Sunday morning and we were just getting started for the day when I spotted one lonely reservation slot open at CP for that night at 9:15. I threw our other dinner plans out the window and spent the day thinking about what was to come. I was not disappointed. Honestly, I had never heard of CP until a quick walk through the Garden District the day before. The outside is striking and, from what I had heard over the course of 24 hours, the menu was equally compelling. We started our visit that Sunday night with a cocktail in the bar. This was the ONLY part of the evening that wasn't a total 5-star experience. I love a good cocktail, and I'm not too picky. But my choice (Cucumber Mint Gimlet) was so tart it was tough to drink. No matter, the food and experience well made up for this false start. We sat in the courtyard - a MUST in my opinion. I dined on their famous Turtle Soup and Quail, and both were the best of either I've had. I can't remember what my other half had since I was so absorbed in my own meal, but he was equally delighted. CP is one of those places that truly lives up to the hype. I can't wait to visit again!
Very long wait after you call in your order and disorganized when you get in the place.  Not enough cashiers to ring up takeout and many people waiting.

THis is such a hidden jewel of SB, I have friend show live there and had never been.
The vegan cinnamon buns are to die for and on a long weekend you can only buy 3 at a time so the 4 of us fought over the 3.
The bread are so good and when they are right out of the oven it's magically 
A business run any ALL woman wooo hooo and they were working hard in the shop.
Totally worth 5 stars plus sad I don't live in SB but also good as I would be there too regularly

Fountain Square, metal, concert posters, and walking through the window is how I first experienced Kuma's Corner. Went here for the first time and it was such a great experience. Hostess was so amiable and helpful. We were seated faster than expected. Once we got to our table we were surrounding my concert posters and photographs of artists. Lots of cool stuff to look at inside the restaurant. Our waiter was equally as great as the hostess. I ended up getting the Buffalo Chicken Tenders which were everything I wanted and more. Great flavor and just enough pieces. When looking at my parties burger and fries (all names after bands) I knew I needed to come back to try it. Everything looked good, tasted good, and the service was great. I would heavily recommend for those that want rock (mostly metal) playing in the background and a good ambiance. The whole venue is more "darker" than most so you have to enjoy that. Can't wait to go back to try the burgers! Hopefully the Iron Maiden Burger!

First time to Daydreamers and I know we will go back.  Super casual. We walked by looking for a breakfast spot and friendly staff waved us in. Open Wed to Sunday 830 to 2 for breakfast and lunch only, with limited cocktails, locally brewed Crooked Thumb beer and regular beer and limited wine selections.  Got the scoop on why menu is so diversified: Chef Chris is from England and Sous Chef Maria is from Hidalgo Mexico. You can order main dishes with a side of Bangers and beans or rice and beans, and specials of the week are posted.  On a walk about" that morning and did not want a heavy breakfast. Staff suggested the SHAM-vocado -est with sautéd spinach and fruit for $10.99. A satisfying low carb option, and... staff brought lots of samples of other dishes.  Next time we will order Honey Bourbon Eggs Benedict and a Womellete. A unique egg option, Womellettes use 4 whisked eggs, fresh ingredients to order, and eggs coked in a waffle iron to create a fluffy, but crispy outside. We are going back to try both dishes.

Just recently heard about this restaurant and was looking forward to trying it. Went with a group of friends last night and this place is. A vegan lovers heaven! The food was super gourmet yet homestyle Mexican fare with a bunch of other comfort food choices like Mac-n-cheese and faux meat Sammy's. Fresh kombucha on tap. Highly recommend the jungle tamale . Beautiful decor and ambience with reggae vibes. A place you can bring your lady or get down with the boys. Family vibes. 100% Plant-based. A must try (and I'm a super picky Vegan chef)

We ordered the South Philly Hoagie, regular cheesesteak with provolone and tater tots. Everything was pretty dry and lacked flavor. My husband is from South Jersey and knows cheesesteaks and was completely unimpressed. Staff was friendly and decor was fun, but we will not be back.

Probably the worst experience when I comes to bar food. The burger was burnt to a crisp and the Cuban sandwich was soggy and didn't even resemble a real Cuban sandwich. I thought it would be a good choice after seeing the pictures on door dash but I was incredibly wrong. I wouldn't recommend this place.
Mimosas are strong. Would've given a 5 but the chicken and waffles wasn't exactly what I was expecting. Still pretty good though.
Salad tasted like lettuce had been frozen. Only one salad dressing available. Scampi overcooked and though. Marsala sauce too strong, as if it had not been reduced enough. We won't be going back.

4 of us went here for the first time and were all blown away! The staff is amazing- they are all pleasant, all work together, and were all knowledgeable. I was up in the air on a drink and our main server asked me a few questions and said ok I got it and came back with an awesome cocktail- you don't get that kind of thing at many restaurants nowadays. We made sure to all get something different on the menu so we could try as much as possible and all loved everything. The camarones rellenos and queso de camarones appetizers were so good we devoured them! The costilla ribeye and the salsa tequilas shrimp were my favorite dinner dishes if I had to choose. We all got different cocktails which were all great as well. We racked up quite a bill but it was worth every penny and we will definitely be back!!
PS park at 1500 locust and you can get a voucher from the restaurant for $10 parking ;)

Always have a good meal whenever I order food from this place. Also the fact that they are open a little later is extremely convenient. The Sushi is tip top, and the servers and chefs are very nice. This place is a regular stop on my list of places to order out from.

Put myself on the wait list as instructed on door.  Two women came up and called server came out, she sat them, ignored me even after I said excuse me.  She finally came back out and I explained that I was on the wait list. She stopped blinked twice and said "excuse me go ahead and talk"  what in the world?  I was done.  In a time when businesses are suffering, you may want to educate your staff in customer service.

Love love love this place, I hate to say oh this Chicago style food is awesome at a place in Indianapolis but this Chicago food is seriously amazing.
I was born in Illinois but I have made Indianapolis home for the past 8 years. I'll admit sometimes I get a tad nostalgic for foods of my youth.
Fat Dans is the place to go to cure that. They have 2 locations and I just happened to be downtown so I decided to hit up the location that's across from the Rathskeller.
I think they have maintained steady business since they opened, its typically always crowded. Since I usually am on my own, I don't have to much of an issue grabbing a place at the bar which I did. The bar tended greeted me right away with water and menus.
Fat Dans has a lot of local and none local craft beer options. The food is why I came, tons of options but I for some reason was craving a Chicago style dog. Fat Dans is the only place that gets it right for me 3 hours south of Chicago, its the only way to eat hotdogs, and it hit the spot! Thanks, Fat Dans for getting Chicago right, so right that I'll look past all of the Cubs decor. Go, White Sox!

Worst pad thai I've ever had. Inedible. Mushy noodles and it tasted like a chlorinated pool. I don't like to see food go to waste and I tried to save it with salt, spice, and lime... still bad. It was delivery and still hot-- if I had been in the restaurant, I would have sent it back and left (and I've never done that). Really disappointed.

Husband tasted it and agreed. He was otherwise happy with his seafood dish. I also got a roll and it was okay, middle of the road. Definitely won't be going back because of the terrible pad thai, but even if that was a one-off mistake, the other food was subpar.

Very good Thai! I had been wanting to try it for awhile and found myself in the area recently so stopped to get takeout (it was take out only due to COVID19). I ordered and it was ready within 20 minutes. They bring it outside for you so you don't have to go in, were masked and gloved. The masaman curry was really good, one of the best I've had in STL. My husband liked his Pad See Ew. My son enjoyed the crab rangoon. Everything was fast, friendly and tasty. We will be back!
Noo way this place wasn't worth it yes it's a cute cute hole in the wall restaurant but the food was plain out disgusting!! Literally took 3 bites and nope couldn't do it!

We ordered a large deluxe for carry out last night. It was cooked to perfection and looked just like the one on their ads. Imo's quality ingredients combined with the generous quantity of toppings are why this remains our all time favorite.

I saw another review that said that Compere Lapin is a tricky restaurant to review and I'd have to agree.

First things first, the good. I visited last week for my birthday dinner and was very excited after seeing and hearing all of the good reviews. The online reservation process was simple and we were able to get a table with ease. Upon arrival, we were greeted very warmly by the staff member at the host stand. The atmosphere was perfect for a birthday dinner and our server was awesome. Tables were spaced out and all staff wore masks. There were also instructions for how to best interact with your server on the table which I thought was a nice touch. My friend and I really enjoyed the experience overall. 

Now for the could have been better. Unfortunately for all of the awesomeness that is the restaurant itself and the service, I did not really enjoy the food. I'm an adventurous eater who loves all types of different cuisines and flavor combinations so I was pretty excited to taste the creations here based on the menu descriptions. However, most of what we ordered was very bland and lacked flavor in my opinion. 

We started with the pig ears and conch croquettes. The pig ears were tasty and reminded me of cracklins which I love. However, if you're a texture person, the extra crunch of the cartilage may throw you off. The conch croquettes were delicious the pineapple tartar sauce was a nice partner. These were by far my favorite part of the meal. For our entrees, I got the s

Very good coffee, both iced and hot. Sandwich's are large for the price and big enough to share. The service can be a bit slow but they make everything to order. If you have a hard time finding the it's because although they are in the mall area they are attached to Maggios Little Italy. I ordered the hand carved ham and Swiss and it's worth going back for.

What a wonderful experience. Thank you Peter for the best onion soup in Florida the introduction to scotch eggs. I can eat a dozen. Crisps, yes. The Shepard's pie with its definitive taste of lamb and herbs. Thank you for the nice friendly atmosphere and wonderful bread pudding with real whip cream. Wonderful experience. 

We are back and it's the same. Thank you. Good food warm atmosphere great staff great beers. Cricket on the Tele

Sat at the bar which serves the full menu. Bartender was great and it was a nice atmosphere. However, the food was nothing special... had the crab Mac and cheese (recommended by the bartender) and a house salad. The salad was good (hard to mess up a salad). The Mac and Cheese was okay but nothing great. I've definitely had better mac and cheese out of a box. The Mac and cheese was very watery and didn't have a lot of flavor. Maybe I got a bad batch but not a dish worth bragging about. They had other items on the menu that looked good, so I would consider coming back to try something different.

Decided to finally get off my butt and see what all the fuss was about, and DANG I was happy I did. 

First off yes I admit I didn't get the hot salami sandwich,  I'll get it next time. The meatball sub on garlic cheese bread just looked too good to pass up. And I don't say this lightly. I'm really quite picky when it comes to meatballs, I don't order them unless they come highly recommended.  These were very good, with a sauce that was flavorful and not too sweet. The bread was the best part, it had a toasty crispness and I could taste the gaaaaahlic. I'm really looking forward to getting to know The Hill better in the next few months!
Good solid food. Menu is very diverse. Great pizza and cheesteaks. If your meeting someone for a meal it is a great lace to go. Large dining room, friendly watresses and a full menu to choose from

Very surprised at the food quality! Bacon appetizer was excellent. Wife had a great Turkey Burger and my Hot Nashville Sandwich was just as advertised..... Hot and delicious. Good fries too! 
Service was fast and efficient. Sat at the bar and watched multiple TV's and sports. We'll go back.

Love this place! Never had a bad meal! And the cocktails are great too! One evening my husband suggested a cocktail and the bartender made it for him and even came up with a name for it. So fun. 21 and older though, so no kids.

Absolute Idiots working here. Instead of homefries they give you french fries. Ordered two large pancakes and instead got 3 baby panakes. Food was cold. Avoid this place like the plague. When we called to try to rectify our order, the girl answering I don't think had a brain and then transferred to us to her dad who was also was extremely rude. Do yourself a favor and avoid a giant headache.

Pollo Loco Restaurant has been remodeled. It's nice and clean to walk into. Customer service is great and food quality is excellent. Meal prices are very affordable. I highly recommend the "New version of Pollo Loco"

Here we are in 'pandemic 2020' and pretty much all the Chinese have been run out of America... can barely find one open. So I guess this is the go to now. Never been here before, but couldn't even go inside for a menu so had to try and pull one up on my crappy data. So pulled up to the window, saw the angus and decided to try that... was told that would be like a 10 minute wait so scratch that. Fell back on the teriyaki chicken, wanted to try the strawberry tea that was on the website... didn't have that so scratch that too. Wife wanted white rice with shrimp, out of that too so scratch that. Ended up with a small portion of what we tried to get but all in all it tasted ok.

Time after the time we go for the tasty chips and crack sauce and are left disappointed because of the quality and quantity of their entrees. Last night we got the fajaitas for 2 for $30 and it had 6 slices of chicken and 6 slices of steak. Biggest rip off! Stick to the free chips and happy hour margaritas

This was our first visit to this charming deli in the funk zone. Since my wife and I are both Greek, we decided to try the gyro. We were hoping that Metropulos' version of this classic Greek sandwich would be better than the subpar versions so often served by various eateries. At first bite, the pita was fresh and tasty. The homemade tzatziki was balanced
between yogurt and cucumber, with just the right hint of garlic. The meat was tender, and perfectly cooked with the proper seasoning. Fresh tomatoes and onions completed this outstanding gyro, the best we've had outside of Greece. The accompanying peasant salad was a
tasty and healthy side to our meal.

I was looking forward to dining here after hearing rave reviews. I was sadly disappointed. Service was horribly slow. Our waiter was quick to advise us to order our appetizers & entrees at the same time. Water glasses were filled 10 minutes after we were seated. It took 20 minutes for our drinks to arrive with apologies for the wait because they had a large group at the restaurant. Reservations are required so they should have adjusted staff so other guests weren't impacted. The appetizers were very good-saucy lady oysters, Tennessee charcuterie & fried chicken skins.  Another long wait for entrees. There were four of us & we all ordered different dishes. I ordered the Florida Wreckfish. The waiter described it as being similar to grouper. It was not. It was tough as a boot & had such a strong fishy smell that I could only eat two bites. The waiter made no comment as he cleared plates. No, how was your meal? Nothing. Don't think I will be back.

John and Molly's is one of my fav spots. Kinda like cheers ..where everyone knows your name. Amazing food-great portions. Cold drinks and the people who work here are super sweet and friendly. Always fast and attentive service. No mistakes ever. Thanks always guys!

Finally tried this place tonight after drooling over the menu. We got the Gentilly pizza. It was incredible. Crust was A+ (traditional thinnish crust) and toppings balance was perfect. Gouda and pesto worked super well together. 
We also got the Ultimate Cheese bread, and it ruled. We gotta try the wings next. 
I think we found a new regular pizza place!
First timer here. The food was good. Had catfish and fries. Can't go wrong with that. It was 16.99. Service was kind of slow however after we were seated. Would go back for the food.

Went today and we got two shakes - different flavors.   Worst shakes we've ever had.  They were so thick we couldn't even drink them.  Their ice cream also tasted off.  Not sure what it was... we got one birthday cake shake and one cookie dough and they both didn't taste good.   We won't be back.
Service and food are getting worse and worse. Used to love this place. Probably won't order or be back.
First time at this location, won't be back. Service was quick, but employees have the nastiest attitudes in customer service. I see why they're rated at 1.5 stars.

My husband had the muffaletta and it was amazing. I loved the bread on this sandwich. I had the creole shrimp which came with salad or green beans but scored both. This dish is great and an excellent price. The portions are generous and staff is very polite. They are practicing COVID guidelines so feel safe to dine in or take out.

The food was good and the ingredients were fresh, but they commit highway robbery if you order online to go. I ordered extra chicken in my bowl which cost an additional $3.70. When I received my order it only consisted of one serving size of chicken (which is small to begin with). Normally I don't let something like this bother me, but if you're charging an arm and leg for extra chicken you better add it.

The staff employed here are also very lackluster. I was the only customer in the store and was not greeted nor helped despite clearly being confused about how to pickup my online order. 

I will not be returning to NAYA due to these reasons.

Always great food and service at Barcelona! The brussel sprouts are amazing and so is the hanger steak. I do wish they had the bacon wrapped dates on the menu again. 

Be aware that the exact part number has to be present to be seated. I did not know that since my cousin made the reservation. It was also slightly annoying that you couldn't even sit at the bar at a distance since it was reserved due to COVID.
Amazing taste. Don't be intimidated by having to cook the meat yourself. Beef pork and chicken

I have been to this location before and the service is  usually great 
This time we were rushed and the quality of the  food was disappointing 
We had eggs Benedict likebwe always do with two varieties 
They increased the amount of big biscuit and decreased the amount of food
Disappointed 
I will try again next time but I give it a C this time.

Prepare to waste about an hour or more for Togo orders. Also expect stuff to be missing because they are very disorganized. I gladly nominate this place for the most fucked up BBQ in Tucson. If you are wondering where the owner is, he does not care about his business. He is probably sipping tea somewhere in the Bahamas.
Soooooooo I just wanted to say thank you for the bestest yes I said bestest wings and shrimp nachos ever OMG. I inhaled my meal!
They are open again and just as great as ever.  Same menu with some wonderful additions.  Same kitchen staff as before so the quality of the food is as good as (if not better than) pre-COVID.

This was a great place to frequent when i got tired of BlackBirds barely and toppings pizza...The last few times I've been to this location 2 employees made me feel very unwelcome when i spoke asking how are you she made it her business raise her voice and ask me again as to you say don't worry about how I'm doin what to you want on your pizza then she seemed irritated when i asked for more toppings..Go apply for a job you want if you hate dealing with the public i won't be goin her again
Love this place from the food to the decor to the staff everything is so good here and the monkey bread is delicious this place is a must!

Cute little coffee shop in Boise.  I got the latte that was perfect.  My honey got a drip coffee that was a bit more acidic than she prefers.  All in all a great little place to grab a quick cup of coffee

Went here with some friends after they had raved about the food. I will say, I may have been spoiled with good Thai food throughout my life, but Lemongrass was just fine. I did like their food, but it wasn't remarkable. We might have been there on a bad night, but it took very long to get our food. Well over an hour at least. And it seemed a lot of other people were waiting for a significant amount of time as well. The restaurant wasn't packed, so I don't think it was that. My friends claim that their take out is pretty quick and delicious, so I'll probably order food from them again, but I don't know if I'd go back and sit down to eat considering the wait time. 
The crab rangoons were good and I got some spicy tofu noodles that I really enjoyed. It wasn't my favorite Thai food, but for Bellevue it's pretty good.

Do yourself a favor and visit this lovely restaurant in New Orleans. The service is unmatched. The staff truly cares about your experience. From the time my family and I walked through the door the team from the greeter to the "DJ", to the servers, to the manager, to the cooks were amazing!!!!

The food is absolutely amazing! I don't even know where to start... of course with the chargrilled oysters with garlic butter and Parmesan! There are absolutely no words to describe these oysters!!!! We were trying to figure out how to get them back to Houston!

The crab cakes, fried fish and seafood nachos were delish!!!

I now have a apple music playlist named after Mr. Ed's!!! The music was soulful and sultry.

Ordered a beyond meat burger when i received it it was a beef patty. Please do better. I have a food allergy and cannot consume red meat, had i not checked the patty before biting into it.... please do better.

Didn't expect it but, Jean-Georges Philadelphia was truly excellent. Whatever your in the mood for, they have it. I ordered Tuna Tartare, which was outstanding. It was so flavorful and delicious. The workers were great, I didn't have any issues, everything went smoothly with my order and service. Overall, would definitely come back.
My Cajun chicken pasta was swimming in grease. The flavors were good, but I'm assuming she uses an entire stick of butter for this recipe.

We went for my boyfriend's birthday and he received a signed birthday card from some of the staff.  The food was amazing and the staff attentive. We felt like we had the European experience. We were there for almost three hours. The French Onion soup was straight out of the oven and one of the best ones I have had in the States. We ate the Duck and Wagyu for our main courses. Definitely recommend these dishes! The best duck I've ever eaten. We were too full for dessert, but we will be back.
The staff here are so nice and awesome. Food selections they have a lot to offer and great prices. It's also great in taste. The also have a drive thru if in a hurry.

Ten deep at "The Cubby Hole"  everyone starting their Morning with an Amazing cup of Heaven! Delicious Coffee, I overheard A LATTE of Orders for "Lattes" ... Also Cappuccinos and espressos!   #Yummm  
A great menu with a Wide selection and Many fun things to  Look at !  Super nice people and Very clean 
I cannot Wait to Come Back!  

The staff are very jovial and Always Smiling and it makes you feel Fantastic to Just Be HERE!  
I Highly Recommend this place!  It's Right SMACK in the middle of Main Street Moorestown and It surrounded by love and happiness and the Sense Of Family and Belonging. One visit and Mark My Words!  You. Will. Be. Back!  This place WILL capture Your Heart 
   
Today, I brought my mom here and she Loved it!  I Knew she Would. It's such an Amazing place! 
Seasonally, the owner told me that the French roasts are one of their BIGGEST sellers in the summertime ...  "Blueberry Lemon",...."pumpkin  pie" Of Course in the Fall!  Their omelettes are Fluffy and amazing, but I would have to Say that you shouldn't Limit yourself to Breakfast,  their sandwiches and the lunch menu are Unreal!  #MajorYummminess

Really unique speak easy that you have to try! Don't try to take more than a group of 4 and expect to sit together, tables are tiny and very cramped. The waiting area has some seating but also very small with bathrooms available. Our group of 4 Waited around 45 min on a Saturday night at around 9pm. The bartenders really create amazing cocktails that you can tell they take their time on! Their menus are organized by type of liquor which i LOVE and everything came out in a decent timings. Because it is a speakeasy, the atmosphere is quiet and DARK with minimal lighting. Also no phones!

I absolutely love this place! They have the best Pad Thai around. The customer service is always amazing -- the owner is so nice, and you never have to wait too long for your food. I definitely recommend giving this place to try if you haven't already!

Came here for a surprise birthday celebration for my girlfriend, and the restaurant was super accommodating. I'd originally made my reservation for 8 people based on who had RSVPd, but we had two surprise last-minute adds who showed up on the day of!! Obviously, my girlfriend was thrilled, but I was a little worried about seating those people. However, the waitstaff were so nice about just adding another two-seater table to the end of ours so we could all sit together. I really appreciated it!! Thank you, Scarlett Begonia!

4 stars as opposed to 5 because I selected this place specifically because they state that they have vegan options; however, I can't say that the menu was super vegan-friendly. Yes, they had non-dairy milk options for my coffee, and yes, I was able to order the avocado toast, but that was literally the only vegan option (in terms of food) available, and it was classed as a side, not an entree. If I'm remembering correctly, gluten-free options were specifically marked on the menu, but vegetarian and/or vegan options were not.

In short, great service and great food (based on what the non-vegans shared about their meals), I just wish there were a little more variety in terms of options for people with differing diets. :)

Love this place. The ingredients are sourced from Italy and you can tell each pizza variety is crafted with toppings that belong together! The pizza dough itself is very light and you don't feel terrible after eating a few slices like you would with cheap pizza. I recommend the Chicken Pesto and Michelangelo! 

Bottom line is pay a little more for high quality pizza.

I had the most wonderful service here and I needed to tell the world! 

All drinks are half priced right now all day every day when you order through the app. And so when an ocean water craving hit-ya girl GAVE IN. 

I parked in a spot. Placed an order in the app. Hit a button that said "I am here" and selected the space I was in. Then it occurred to me: am I the world's worst best friend if I get myself Sonic without ordering one to bring my husband? Fear of that label mixed with overwhelming love for my dude had me quickly placing a second order. This time for a completely inferior bevy-cherry limeade.  Moments later the kindest gentleman was out by my window bringing my drink...I swear I couldn't have ordered any faster! 

I felt shame. I felt guilt. I felt embarrassed. 

And then sure enough just as quickly as he left he was back with my second drink. Instead of being annoyed and bitter that I made him run in the heat TWICE, he was simply confused. I clarified that it was my order and then he laughed! He laughed and I told him the story and he totally understood! His kindness and cheerful spirit was even more satisfying than my liquid sugar. 

Thank you, sir. And hey, thanks Sonic for giving us all day happy hour. I think we needed this right now!

This would be my third time here and I have to say the service and food are pretty damm good. Unfortunately, the dining area is not much too look at and it does have some age to it. Last night we had a singer to go along with our food. Great place to bring the family as they will try to accommodate as much as possible. 

I had the churrasco while my friend had the salmon. The sides were tasty and so was my steak. Didn't hear many complaints from my friend about his fish. Their cheese flan and tres Leche cake were pretty slammin. Our server was always on top of us making sure we were enjoying our experience. 

Whenever I'm in town, I always try to stop in. Keep up the good work! 

"My review is strictly my opinion based on my experience and interaction with the business and/employees while they provided me a service, food, or merchandise. This review is not to be translated as fact. My review is truthful to the best of my ability and is not intended to present harm to the business but to encourage them to perform better or allow them to continue being awesome. I have not received any monetary gain for writing this review" - Bruno F

Called in just now to place a to go order and the guy was so rude. If you don't like your job maybe look for another one......just a thought also they were out of the bagel my wife wanted  she asked "well what kind do you have " he says " well what do you want".......really?

Very disappointing. Went in and ordered the chicken adobo to go. Was told this was very popular and would be ready in five minutes. Order taker was very spacey. Didn't really feel like he was hearing me. THIRTY minutes later he brings me my food..... on a tray. Feeling confirmed. Asked for it to go. Took the food outside to eat and it's cold anyway.  Not going back anytime soon. Shame considering how much my friends talk it up

This place is simply great.  Service is spot on. They don't skimp on ingredients and pay attention to the details. Prices are fair and the food is traditional. There can be a wait for Saturday dinner but it's worth the wait.

Thrilled we stopped here after kayaking at Weeki Wachee springs. The patio is comfortable with a canal & marina view. Our server, Katie, was attentive & friendly. Kid's fish & chips was huge & delicious. The clam basket was great. Blackened grouper sandwich was the fresh catch of the day and really good--flaky, clean, & huge--plus tasty bun and good remoulade.  Fries were some of the best... flour dusted so super crispy. The sautéed veggies were julienned and really tasty as well. If you live nearby or are in the area, give it a try! (I wanted to try their scallops or fish Reuben bc they looked so good coming out... another time!)

We had heard great things but don't get the hype. We went on a weekday to avoid the huge crowds and were seated right away. The service was great and they were very attentive to dietary needs. The food was not what we expected, but still a decent meal. Definitely overpriced and not worth the hype.

The Downtown Sporting Club is an experience package and not just a bar. There is so much to do in this one building. You have axe throwing, lawn games, an arcade, big screen and seating area for Sports Games. On the top is a roof top bar with games. There is also options to dine in and eat different types of food. We could have been in this place for a long time but we choose to visit some other local bars. 

If you want to do axe throwing, I suggest going to their website and reserving a spot because they usually book up fast. It is 20 dollars per person for an hour of throwing. They also do an axe-throwing league, which I thought was cool and a fun activity. If I lived in Nashville, I would do that. 

Overall: I give this place 5 stars and highly recommend that everyone who visits or lives in Nashville to check it out.

Walking up it looks run down, it is very old looking inside with a very short ceiling. I stand at 5'8" and I felt like I was hitting the ceiling. It's very tight inside and they have outdoor sitting but we weren't able to sit there as a party of 40 had just left and a party or 30 was coming. 

Our waitress was good. I had ordered the pulled pork sandwich without bun and bbq bake beans. I didn't like the beans. The sauces were good, original, mustard & sweet all are made in house. My husband got the fish tacos - he thought they were good and also got fries & grilled wings. 

When they are making fish - the entire restaurant smells horrible. Like gut wrenching and have to gasp for air it literally smells nasty.

This place used to be a neighborhood casual italian place - now it's a homey vietnamese place! 

Tips/Tricks - order at the counter and order anything! (It's all good). Street Parking 

Food: I'm a big fan of their spring rolls here. Their Bun (Vermicelli Bowl) and Banh Mi are great, but their spring rolls are truly outstanding! 

Service: Really awesome! I think that the friendly service, beyond that of the food or atmosphere, makes this place stand out! The owner is real friendly but not too "in your face". 

Atmosphere: I've come here for a whole range of things: break from studying at french truck, reading, dinner with friends, a weekly mandarin speaking group - this place is perfect for them all! It's usually relatively quiet and truly feels like a neighborhood spot.

Truly an IV classic, and the Mac Daddy is perrrrrfect for when you're craving something cheesy and greasy. I really appreciate the little details- every inch of bread I got was buttery garlic cheesy goodness. Props to the one guy manning the place by himself. You can also get $1 off by liking them on Facebook or following on Instagram! It's a lot of food and lasted me two meals which was fantastic as a college student on a budget. I can definitely see myself coming more often when I get the munchies or am craving mac and cheese.

This place was totally blah. I ordered the enchilada plate with beans and rice. Everything was a but dry and totally flavorless. The enchiladas tasted like they were pre-frozen. Plus they messed my order up and gave me the wrong meat so I was stuck eating pork enchiladas when I ordered chicken. The meat had NO flavor. Won't return.
The service is good, the food is fresh and delicious. We have gone several times and have had great experience each time

Hawkers has deliciously flavored food that hits on mostly pan-Asian fair with aplomb. 

Consistency is under-valued in a restaurant and whoever runs the kitchen delivers in that regard. In over 6 visits, I've never been dissatisfied by the food. 

I would say that no one should get stuck too much on specific menu items. Once I started venturing out and trying different items, I was always happy with the new choices.

My family and I visited Petra because of all the great reviews from the past. There is no denying that the food is more than worth the visit. We especially enjoyed the falafel and chicken Shawarma. Our server was spot on and very attentive to everything we needed. My only point of contention was the fact that the food took so long to cook. I say this totally understanding that there was a large party outside at the same time we arrived, but I didn't think our orders were too difficult to prepare. Again, we loved the food and would recommend this place in a heartbeat, but the slow service prevented a fifth star.

The Golden Inn is my absolute favorite Chinese restaurant in the entirety of Tampa Bay. I have been visiting this establishment for several years now. The owner is an absolute pleasure to speak to. She is very dedicated and that dedication is reflected in the quality and flavor of the food. For my fellow vegetarians, the Golden Inn also has the best tofu options of any Chinese restaurant, period. From the quality of the food, the helpful staff, to their delicious vegetable rolls - I couldn't possibly speak more highly about this establishment.

For as much as I like the food, canceling my Grubhub order nearly an hour after you accepted it is never okay.  That messes up my planning for the day so much that it more than offsets the goodwill from previous deliveries.  You should have at least credited my account with something for my trouble.  This used to be my go-to delivery option for healthy food, and now I'll be looking elsewhere.

I am 82 years old and l love the food here . . . the customer service is excellent.  The staff is very friendly and kind to me whenever I call. I like the food and the variety.  It is definitely my favorite place to go for lunch and dinner for a quick bite to eat.

First off, I truly commend this place for the sheer variety of desserts offered. They have baked goods (brownies, pies, and macaroons), frozen dairy (ice cream, liquid nitrogen ice cream, frozen yogurt), smoothies, açaí bowls, coffee, tea, and even bubble tea. Then, you have items that aren't desserts at ALL- like Korean ramen. A bit all over the place, and nothing that's truly quality foods. And I've given it MULTIPLE chances- and came here at least 3 times. (Okay, but why come to a place so many times when I don't seem like a fan??! It's because  they always have open chairs in their nice, air conditioned store, unlike Franklin Fountain where all the seating seems to be outdoors) 

The frozen yogurt had more ice than yogurt, and the ice cream is pretty mediocre. If you're here, I do suggest the Belgian waffles. It'a nothing particularly special- just some warm waffles with cool simple toppings. The temperature differential does make it quite good. 

Not to mention the teenage boys that worked the place couldn't stop bickering with each other, which was unprofessional but at least they're pretty entertaining.
Nice staff . Vegetables and corn were well seasoned and tasty . Main courses - redfish special and New Orleans sampler were ok-food could have arrived hotter and w more flavor
This is a great place. It's expensive but the portions are huge so there will be leftovers. I love the beef gyro platter. Their salad is also very good. Good place

excellent service ! the girls here know how to make customers welcome. The food is you typical gastropub cuisine , but well done, The burgers are marvolous, I had the mushroom soup a while back during the fall months and it was the best i have ever had in any five star restaurant.

We had a great experience. Cheery attentive waitress, open, relaxed, but energized atmosphere. Crabcakes had some shell bits in it, but were delicious. Redfish, shrimp grits, pasta were excellent. Bread pudding and pecan pie dessert were outstanding. Highly recommended.

Came across Nikka Ramen back in August when went on a weekend get away to Goleta. Love it! I have had Ramen in my City but nothing like this, it was so good that we had to stop today. Coming back from Lompoc we called our order in and it was ready. This time we had the Tonkotsu Original "Shiro Ramen with Chicken Chashu. Let me apologize we did not take pictures, because one spoonful of that delicious broth and we forgot about everything. It was so delicious with the thin noodles and good portion of chicken that we just had to eat it all up! Thank You Nikka Ramen, I will be back soon.

By far my favorite place to have some biscuits! Everything was delicious, and we sampled a lot!!! The chicken was probably my favorite, great flavor, not overly coated with batter, just perfect. I loved the neighborhood it was in as well. Nice little walk from downtown. There is bit of a line so definitely be prepared for that! Would definitely come back if in Nashville again!

A must go! The food was fantastic, service was wonderful and the atmosphere was so cute! We came for brunch and everyone at our table absolutely loved what they ate! They serve unique drinks- I had a prickly pear mimosa as well as the norm! Their food tastes farm fresh and defiantly homemade! A great culinary experience!

Did curbside pick up last night for our anniversary .  Often go here and always love it, but now it's the time of Covid. Ordering was easy and when I called, they told us about specials not on the online menu. The food was ready when they said it would be and was still warm when I got home. Veal chop and Halibut specials were wonderful and the salads were great too. They were very appreciative and we were happy to be able to help them keep going during these terrible times. Please help them out. You will not be disappointed.

Jordy ginsburg

We've tried to order from the Wilmington location twice online. Once with Uber Eats and second in the Bonefish website. 
The first time, we scheduled for ASAP, which was said to be 45 mins, but ended up being never.  I tracked and it would say was getting picked up and then would change back to being prepared. This happened for over 3 hours and finally was cancelled.  We never got a text, an email, or even a call that our order had been cancelled.  All this info is given, so there's no reason why we weren't notified.
Today, put an order in scheduled for 6pm, received an email around 5:30 saying there was an issue with the system communicating our order and to call the store.  Called the store, no record of our order.  
This is very frustrating especially when you're hungry and never get your food.

The food is great if you don't count the fact we had to send a steak back for sending it out to us completely charred and over cooked and then sent its replacement practically bleeding.  We had 4 people and our bill was over $700. I'm sorry but when you go out and spend these kinds of prices you expect to be treated with a little more than you would expect at iHop. We had to constantly grab our server for his attention. I think he only voluntarily came to our table a few times. When we asked for 2 top shelf cognacs they had made it seem like a complete inconvenience because they had to "check the back for another bottle". I'm sorry we want to spend another $100 on two beverages! Not sure how our waiter landed a job there.

Got a menu at mailbox ( hate that) typically throw out.
Somehow kept.  Decided to order tonight.
Very, very good.  Totally surprising.  Got margarhetta with Italian sausage.  Omg! So good! Will definitely order another time. Would like however slightly thinner crust. I have really been wanting good pizza with quality ingredients in philly for delivery.

I was walking out of Nam Phuong after having lunch thinking about how thirsty I was when I saw a horde of school children excitedly running towards and into Mr. Wish. I loves me a good smoothie & boaba tea place so I took it as a sign that I needed to check them out and dropped in.  

Upon entering, I discovered that Mr. Wish actually boast itself as being "the No. 1 Fruit Tea Franchise from Taiwan", so no wonder it was bustling with customers.

After looking over their drink menu I decided to order one of their Mango Smoothies, which is one of their most popular best sellers.  It was really refreshing and hit spot. I could taste that they use real fresh fruit in their smoothies too, which I really appreciated. 

I can see what all the hype is about when it comes to Mr. Wish. I will definitely keep them in mind for my smoothie needs the next time I'm in Philly. I have my eyes on their tea cakes for the next time I have a chance to pay them a visit.

This is my favorite relatively fast food restaurant around.  If my wife would let me, I could eat here four or five days a week.  My favorite is the Chicken Mole, served on Mondays.  It is made with dark meat, and is very tasty.  I also recommend the shrimp quesidilla.  It's a little spicy, even without the salsa.  Sometimes, my wife and I go to TacoSon for breakfast and get the Breakfast Burrito.  While we aren't vegetarians, that's what we order.  Its a lot of food.  I love their green salsa.  My wife prefers the red.  The green is a little spicier.  When we aren't worried too much about calories, we get the guacamole, or queso with taco shells.  They give extra shells if you eat too many.  Can't recommend another restaurant for better value for money.

The wait staff was very attentive But not in that constant annoying way when you can't have a conversation because the waiter is always checking in. The food was really delicious, I had the RoganJosh which was really amazing. It was very obvious that they used quality meat as opposed to others that I have eaten in before. The price was very reasonable and I enjoyed the ambience. The place is small but it was not super busy that afternoon so you were still able to have a conversation. My only wish is that they would have had the lunch buffet instead of having to just order off the menu. Otherwise it would've got five stars

A good ol' summer BBQ seems like a thing of the past...... with the 'Rona running rampant, it's hard to get that warm feeling again. Since BBQ for one is a little lackluster, I decided to call on Baby Blues BBQ  Philly. 
BBQ can be tricky, it has to be tender, smokey and in my opinion, plentiful. Nothing is worse than tough BBQ. 
I ordered the barbequed beef brisket, baked beans, chicken smoked rice, collard greens and cornbread. The brisket was tasty, tender and juicy but not fatty. The BBQ sauce was delicious, but not enough to go round. The collards were fair and the baked beans were very good. 
I ordered chicken smoked rice and it was good and even though the cornbread was tiny, the flavor was great. All in all, it was a decent, filling meal and if they would have supplied more of that delicious BBQ sauce, I would be wiping it off my cheeks right now.
Pretty good poke. I would give it the 5th star if the jalapeños were fresh, not canned. Big selection of other things as well, not just seafood.

Such a gem in the New Tampa area!! Having dinner here after watching a movie with friends made my day. I ordered a chicken philly, and the setup of the diner is so that there is an L-shaped eating area surrounding the kitchen, and we got to see the owners cook our food in front of us. All of the ingredients were super fresh, and the cuban bread was toasted to perfection with crispy, lightly browned edges. The chicken was so tender that I couldn't even tell that it was white meat, and the rest of the filling contained juicy bell peppers and flavorful onions and a melted slice of cheese. I only had to add a bit of salt to my sandwich (pro tip you need to grind the salt from the shaker- I was wondering why it didn't work super well at first but I guess it prevented me from excessive sodium intake LOL), but it was so satisfying in a way that made me feel full but not heavy! The owners are such lovely people as well- you can tell that they put a lot of heart and love into their food. I can't believe I've never been to this place until now! This honestly made my day. Will definitely be back for the delicious food and friendly ambience!

Disappointed as this place was highly recommended. When I called to order the pizza it was quoted 45 minutes. My husband was there 15 minutes after my call. When my husband went to pick it up and asked for garlic bread as the pizza was not supposed to be ready yet, he was told it will take 4 minutes for the bread. When I opened the pizza box, the pizza did not look fresh,  I called the pizza place and spoke to the manager who told me that it was my husband fault because he order bread and that the pizza was ready. It is so nice to communicate with people, they should have told my husband the pizza was ready and he would have not ordered the bread.

Great mediterranean join with delicious food and very reasonable prices. We've been getting food from here via Postmates and it's been awesome. Always quick and easy. The only downside is they run out of baklava very qiuckly, so if you have a sweet tooth order early!

Dynamic menu and fun decor make for an enjoyable dining experience. Of what I tried (onion rings, sweet potato fries, bison burger), nothing was of standout quality but it was all fulfilling despite being pricy. Next time I want to try a milkshake!

Corazon Cocina

Attention Gourmet TACO HUNTERS - Prepare to Pause Right Here. Relax and Enjoy, Savor the Flavors. All the reviews are true!

I grew up on LAST = (LA Street Tacos), yes from the old Olvera Street in Downtown LA to the NoHo Barrio (in North Hollywood) to Indio, Yuma Arizona, Guadalajara, Mexico City and beyond. I must confess, I do know tacos very well. Plus Taco Tuesday is on my calendar all year. For anyone with a Taco Deficiency, or if you are simply looking for the very best Gourmet Tacos on the American Riviera, Corazon Cocina is where you need to be ordering dinner.

Corazon Cocina serves exceptionally well prepared, killer recipe Gourmet Tacos. Absolutely the very best in all of Santa Barbara City and the County. Each and every Taco is treated with loving care. The Mole con Pollo Tacos will knock your socks off unless you are wearing beach walkers, zorries, go-aheads, flip-flops, thongs, or huarache sandals.

Okay, the Tacos here are fantastic, however if you love Ceviche check out the Ceviche Tostadas. 

Order at the walk-up counter, the Red Blinky Light coaster will let you know when to pick-up your order. They do get real busy, you may have to wait in the fast moving line up to the counter, it is well worth the wait. Then graze over to the salsa bar and fill up the nice little salsa cups as needed.

Always exceptionally good! I love this place. Consistent quality and timely. You will happy you tried this restaurant.
Went to eat here again our second time in Florida and it was once again Delicious Sushi here is our picture this time we will be back there.

Worst chicken Parmesan I've ever had. Literally just mush with no flavor. But the fried mushrooms, jalapeño poppers, wings and deep dish pizza were great. Definitely will be sticking to the pizza from now on!!

The first two times we ordered from here everything was awesome! I got the chicken burger and gluten free bun (so awesome they offer this) and it was so good! Sweet potato fries were great too and we got a large helping! The third time however our order took over an hour and all 3 sandwiches were wrong. I was very disappointed because our first 2 orders were great, so I wrote in. The manager was extremely kind and offered a very generous discount in return for our bad experience. I would suggest calling and picking up rather than ordering from Grubhub because that's where our issues seemed to be. Overall great food and we will definitely order again!

Found this place while looking for somewhere to to make brother-in-law while he was in town... this place was awesome! Small tiki bar type set up with big table and games to play ( giant uno and jinga) live music and it it was actually really good. Food was delicious got the buffalo chicken quesadilla and Greek fries ... drinks were good too! We will definitely be back.

I recently went for birthday dinner with my family. They have a great inclusive menu that was perfect for everyone, including kids. I am gluten free and there were so many diff choices! The drinks are always great and the happy hour menu is solid!
